sources.title: IFClite — official product site
sources.supports: Browser viewer with local file loading; modular toolkit. These are product claims, not independently benchmarked here.

sources.title: IFClite — official source repository
sources.supports: Open-source toolkit and modular packages; browser, SDK and CLI capabilities.

sources.title: AnkerDB — About
sources.supports: Public product name and BIM information / delivery workflow positioning.

sources.title: OCI Image Specification 1.1.1 — artifact usage
sources.supports: OCI manifests may package content other than container images; typed payload descriptors.

sources.title: OCI Distribution Specification 1.1.1
sources.supports: Registry push/pull interfaces, manifests, blobs and digest verification. Domain semantics remain a separate agreement.

sources.title: ORAS — pushing and pulling artifacts
sources.supports: Single-file and multiple-file artifact transfer, including local registry examples.

sources.title: ORAS — copy artifacts between registries
sources.supports: Explicit registry-to-registry copy and OCI layout transfer; not automatic synchronization.

sources.title: ORAS — registry authentication
sources.supports: Login and authentication still form part of registry deployment and use.

sources.title: ifcx-oci — local prototype README
sources.supports: Read locally at commit be6e081. Reports two-registry loopback push/copy/pull with retained digest; experimental derived IFCX profile, no approval or lossless STEP round trip.

sources.title: buildingSMART — Information Delivery Specification (IDS)
sources.supports: Computer-interpretable information requirements for IFC. Domain tools can read IDS and check IFC against those requirements; OCI only packages and distributes the files.

sources.title: buildingSMART — buildingSMART Data Dictionary (bSDD)
sources.supports: An online service hosting dictionary definitions, classifications and properties. Reservoir tanks here represent references to selected definitions or permitted snapshots, not a local copy of the live bSDD service.

sources.title: CNCF Distribution — deploying a registry
sources.supports: Registry implementation support for TLS and authentication/access restriction, enabled through deployment configuration.

sources.title: CNCF Distribution — token authentication and authorization
sources.supports: Registry token flow supports authenticated clients and repository/action-scoped authorization through an access-control service.

sources.title: zot — registry binaries for local deployment
sources.supports: Official release provides standalone zot registry binaries for macOS, Linux and FreeBSD. Local-binary registry deployment is an available implementation option.

sources.title: Microsoft — OCI artifacts in Azure Container Registry
sources.supports: A cloud registry can store and distribute OCI artifacts using ORAS. Deployment examples on the slide are illustrative, not existing AEC product integrations.

sources.title: IFClite: maintainer decision on whole-file ingestion and layers
sources.supports: Direction: ifc-git derives delta layers and records matching; Layer PRs owns history, merge and review. The proposed portable query contract in these slides is an additional ecosystem proposal.

sources.title: IFClite: proposed scope reconciliation for ifc-git
sources.supports: Documentation proposal narrowing ifc-git to a delivery-to-layer adapter. No implemented OCI adapter or common query profile is claimed.

sources.title: OCI: content descriptors and byte identity
sources.supports: Payload descriptors identify media type, digest and size. Domain semantics, query schemas and identity mappings belong to the proposed AEC profile.

sources.title: buildingSMART discussion: encoding flexibility and interoperable IFC5 artifacts through OCI
sources.supports: Proposal separating IFC semantics, encoding profiles, artifact contract and OCI distribution. Flexible IFCX encodings on this slide are a proposed agreement, not an approved standard.

sources.title: IANA: Apache Parquet media type
sources.supports: Registered application/vnd.apache.parquet media type.

sources.title: IANA: binary glTF media type
sources.supports: Registered model/gltf-binary media type for GLB.

presentation_copy: Extended with three release/change/ifc-git interoperability slides; separate from the main project rebuild.
